review: R5 exact owned systemd fixture source-only independent review
scope: Read both entire fixture source files without modifying them.
Also inspected the already-present cleanup reconcile semantics as context; did not re-review the five production modules.
Scope is this exact nonce-bound once-only unit and its one known bounded child.
findings: The start call is inside the try/finally region. Unacknowledged or failed start reaches actual OwnedCleanup.reconcile; an unknown generation remains a failed observation and cannot authorize a blind stop.
The command allowlist permits only the exact owned unit's stop and its matching observation commands. Stop is attempted at most once.
One resources-before-cleanup ENOSPC injection is expected to remain an error while retirement proceeds; it cannot qualify the full canary as successful.
Successful evidence requires the original held hierarchical cgroup to become empty and deactivated, the original pidfd to report child exit, and the recorded child generation to disappear.
The child moves only itself under the exact owned unit; it sleeps at most 45 seconds after readiness. Setup failure with an acquired pidfd triggers targeted kill and bounded wait.
limitations: No systemd start/stop, service, mount, pressure, Android or Main action was run by this reviewer.
No claim of arbitrary descendants, processes escaped from the owned cgroup, arbitrary failure cleanup, or full wrapper/production qualification.
Admission still requires final manifest/tool pins and root review; peer message is not an execution result.
